# pymagnum (reference for the Magnum plugin)

moon-flare's Magnum Energy plugin (`src/magnum/`, `src/plugins/inverter_magnum/`,
`tools/mf_magnum_dump.c`) is a C port of parts of
[pymagnum](https://github.com/CharlesGodwin/pymagnum) by Charles Godwin,
ported from commit `6f78ed4` (pymagnum 2.0.8). pymagnum is BSD-3-Clause
(see `LICENSE` in this directory); each ported file names the pymagnum file
and function it derives from. `testdata/magnum/allpackets.txt` is pymagnum's
`testdata/allpackets.txt`.
